text.description_html:
Laurey 74628, Aventura Satin Nickel Cabinet Pull

The Small Satin Nickel Aventura Cabinet Pull is made out of zinc. This cabinet handle is a great choice for any home remodel project. The Satin Nickel finish is stunning. The Aventura Satin Nickel Cabinet Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Aventura Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 74628 96mm Pull Aventura Satin Nickel:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3-3/4" (96mm)
  • Overall Length: 4"
  • Width: 1/2"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
